title: MZ RPG MAKER MZ's Default character sprite s but 8D?

posts.author: ArudanIsMe
posts.body: Has anyone ever made an 8 directional version of MZ's default character sprites?(Meaning base version also) not that I need it but it would be cool to use since im using the default base sprites

posts.author: isaac3000
posts.body: I think a plug in exists for that but you would have to add the graphics yourself. Not sure if it was a script for VX Ace or a plug in for MV/MZ though.

posts.author: GalacticGod
posts.body:
I believe there is a DLC for a Diagonal Sprite Generator. (Which you could use on the default character sprites for RPG Maker MZ.
Diagonal Sprite Generator
Want to include taller sprites that can walk diagonally but don’t want to spend all your time drawing them yourself? Then you need the Diagonal Sprite Generator!
plaza-us.komodo.jp

posts.author: Avery
posts.body:
Here you go:
MZ RTP Diagonal characters (Actor 1-3 + Evil + Monster)
These are diagonal (8-dir) versions for RTP characters. OcRam_Char_Converter was used and some pixels were adjusted afterwards.  These sheets can be used with OcRam_Movement for example.  Terms of use: These are RTP edits so you must own RPG Maker MZ license. No need for credits. Please link...
